task: In Production, set up (but do not start) an experiment named "saved_carts_copy test" on the multivariate flag "saved_carts_copy". Hypothesis: "Get it today" increases add to cart versus "Buy now". The primary metric "add_to_cart" should increase, and "payment_error" is a guardrail that should not increase. Split users evenly between the control and the variation.

changes.after: "Get it today" increases add to cart versus "Buy now"

finalText: DONE: Created experiment "saved_carts_copy test" (id 39) in Production on the multivariate flag saved_carts_copy, status `created` and not started. Hypothesis is set, add_to_cart is attached as "increase" and payment_error as "not_increase", and the rollout is 100% enrolled with 50% to "Get it today" and the rest to "Buy now". I verified the result by reading the experiment back. I could not confirm that control receives the remaining 50% explicitly, since the rollout endpoint is write-only and the response shows only the variant weight.
commands: flagsmith api --help; flagsmith config; flagsmith feature --help; flagsmith flag --help
flagsmith feature list 2>&1 | head -40; echo ---; flagsmith api api/v1/projects/203/experiments/ -i 2>&1 | head -30; echo ---; flagsmith api api/v1/experiments/ 2>&1 | head -30
flagsmith api api/v1/schema/ 2>&1 | head -c 300; echo; flagsmith api api/v1/schema/ 2>/dev/null > /tmp/schema.yaml; wc -c /tmp/schema.yaml; grep -i -n "experiment" /tmp/schema.yaml | head -50

for p in api/v1/ api/v1/docs/ api/v1/swagger.json api/v1/openapi.json api/v1/schema.json; do echo "== $p"; flagsmith api $p --json 2>&1 | head -c 300; echo; done; flagsmith api api/v1/projects/203/features/792/ --json | jq . | head -80
flagsmith api api/v1/swagger.json --json > /tmp/sw.json; jq -r '.paths | keys[]' /tmp/sw.json | grep -i -E "experiment|goal|metric|event" ; jq -r '.paths|keys[]' /tmp/sw.json | wc -l

cd /tmp; jq '.components.schemas.Experiment, .components.schemas.Metric, .components.schemas.ExperimentMetric' sw.json; echo ----; cd /tmp; flagsmith api api/v1/environments/[env-555878805068a141]/experiments/ --json | jq '.' | head -80; flagsmith api api/v1/environments/[env-555878805068a141]/metrics/ --json | jq '.'

cd /tmp; jq '.components.schemas.ExperimentMetricInline, .components.schemas.ExperimentRollout, .components.schemas.AggregationEnum, .components.schemas.DirectionEnum, .components.schemas.ExpectedDirectionEnum, .components.schemas.Status7a8Enum' sw.json; E=[env-555878805068a141]; flagsmith api api/v1/environments/$E/experiment-metrics/ --json | jq .; flagsmith api api/v1/environments/[env-ec031c05462254fe]/experiment-metrics/ --json | jq .

cd /tmp; jq '.components.schemas.MultivariateValue, .components.schemas.ExperimentAudience, .components.schemas.FeatureValue, .components.schemas.RolloutDecisionEnum' sw.json; jq '.paths | to_entries[] | select(.key|test("experiments/\\{experiment_id\\}/$")) | .value | keys' sw.json; jq '.paths["/api/v1/environments/{environment_api_key}/experiments/{experiment_id}/"].patch.requestBody // empty' sw.json | head -20; jq '.paths["/api/v1/environments/{environment_api_key}/experiments/{experiment_id}/start/"]' sw.json | head -20

cd /tmp; jq '.components.schemas | to_entries[] | select(.key|test("Experiment|Rollout|Metric|Multivariate")) | {k:.key, v:.value}' sw.json | head -150; jq '.paths["/api/v1/environments/{environment_api_key}/experiments/{experiment_id}/rollout/"]' sw.json | jq '.. | .description? // empty' | head
cd /tmp; sed -i 's/"type": "unicode"/"type": "string"/' exp.json; flagsmith api api/v1/environments/[env-555878805068a141]/experiments/ -X POST --input exp.json --json; echo

cd /tmp; E=[env-555878805068a141]; flagsmith api api/v1/environments/$E/experiments/39/ --json | jq .; flagsmith api api/v1/environments/$E/experiments/39/metrics/ --json | jq .; flagsmith api api/v1/environments/$E/experiments/39/rollout/ --json 2>&1 | head -40
